\begin{lexlean}{Studio.Gui.Approval}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\importmodule{Studio.Agent.Contributor}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: journey,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: 0x6a6f75726e657920617070726f76616c3a204772616e74206f722072656a656374207768617420796f7572206c696e6b6564206167656e742061736b7320746f206368616e67652c20656163682072657175657374206e616d696e672069747320636f6e74656e74206279206120424c414b453320636f6e74656e7420616464726573730a
}

definition{
  name: pending,
  parameters: [agent : Bytes, maintainer : Bytes, digest : Bytes, links : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((match (Studio.Agent.Contributor::standing agent maintainer links)
    | Option.some refusal => false
    | Option.none => true) && (Studio.Agent.Contributor::contentAddress digest)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: decisionEnabled,
  parameters: [maintainerViews : Bool, waiting : Bool],
  result: Bool,
  body: (maintainerViews && waiting),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: actions,
  parameters: [enabled : Bool],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if enabled then 0x616374696f6e206772616e743a20656e61626c65640a616374696f6e2072656a6563743a20656e61626c6564 else 0x616374696f6e206772616e743a2064697361626c65640a616374696f6e2072656a6563743a2064697361626c6564),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: pendingView,
  parameters: [agent : Bytes, scope : Bytes, digest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x7669657720617070726f76616c50656e64696e673a20 agent : Bytes) (prim append 0x2061736b7320746f206368616e676520 scope : Bytes) : Bytes) (prim append (prim append 0x2c20636f6e74656e7420 digest : Bytes) 0x0a : Bytes) : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: present,
  parameters: [viewer : Bytes, agent : Bytes, maintainer : Bytes, scope : Bytes, digest : Bytes, links : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (journey) (if (pending agent maintainer digest links) then (prim append (pendingView agent scope digest) (actions (decisionEnabled (Studio.Runtime::same viewer maintainer) true)) : Bytes) else (prim append (prim append 0x7669657720617070726f76616c526566757365643a20 (prim append (Studio.Agent.Contributor::permission agent maintainer scope digest links) 0x0a : Bytes) : Bytes) (actions false) : Bytes)) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons verb f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons viewer f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons agent f3 => (match f3
          | List.cons maintainer f4 => (match f4
            | List.cons scope f5 => (match f5
              | List.cons digest links => (if (Studio.Runtime::same verb 0x76696577) then (present viewer agent maintainer scope digest links) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
              | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
            | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
          | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
        | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: only_the_maintainer_decides,
  parameters: [waiting : Bool],
  statement: ((decisionEnabled false waiting) = false),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: []
}

theorem{
  name: the_maintainer_decides_a_pending_request,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a6167656e7409707269736d3a616c6578096170702f73726309626c616b65333a3235663236333334363136353063643332346231353762663636333365366461393031373663653237323938316232636237373137616335373933333633373809707269736d3a6167656e743d707269736d3a616c6578) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: another_viewer_cannot_decide,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a6167656e7409707269736d3a6167656e7409707269736d3a616c6578096170702f73726309626c616b65333a3235663236333334363136353063643332346231353762663636333365366461393031373663653237323938316232636237373137616335373933333633373809707269736d3a6167656e743d707269736d3a616c6578) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: shows_why_a_request_is_refused,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request 0x7669657709707269736d3a616c657809707269736d3a6167656e7409707269736d3a616c6578096170702f737263096c617465737409707269736d3a6167656e743d707269736d3a616c6578) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
